definitions.base: slab i: unknowns = degree-8 polynomials in tc in [-1,1] (tau = tau0 + dtau (1+tc)/2) through the stored stage balls at nodes 0 and the radau.py Radau IIA nodes (60-digit binary values as exact rationals); per element kappa = sum d_q N_q(s), T1 Hermite-C4 basis and knots (outer knots XT (1 + C ell^3)^(1/3)); see base.py
definitions.r: r = V~ + k~_xx - (1/4 - a~) p~ - b~ n~ (T5 1.1); computed as r = Re z, A = Im z, z = e^{i theta} int_0^x e^{-i theta} rho_theta, rho_theta = theta_tau - Phi; A is the residual part of the transport varpi
definitions.RF{j}_{design}: Lemma F R_j = (int T_j (d^{j-1} r)^2)^{1/2}, T_j = 28 eta_j^2 Yl^{2j-2} (flattened), d^{-1} r = S1 - S1(ell); designs T5 (ramps 14,28) and opt4n (14,22 for j<=3; 22,30 for j=4)
definitions.RFa{j}_{design}: (int T_j'^2/T_j (d^{j-1} r)^2)^{1/2}  (residual part of Lemma F R^_j, first term)
definitions.RFb{j}_{design}: (int |T_j''| (d^{j-1} r)^2)^{1/2}  (residual part of Lemma F R^_j, second term)
definitions.RFlit{j}: T5 (R) literal / T1 resid.py: (28 int eta^2 x^{2j-2} (d^{j-1} r)^2)^{1/2}, eta = S(ln(y/14)/ln 2), y = x + STIP, d^{-1} r = S1
definitions.scalars: sup over the slab of |defects|: eps_ell = ell_tau + Q(ell) - c ell, eps_lnlam, eps_c, eps_t (scalar ODEs); closure_q = q~(ell) (far-end height above the axis), turning_t1 = t~1(ell) = cos theta(ell), A_end = A(ell), D_end = c q(ell) + b t1(ell) + A(ell) + eps_ell (= b1(ell) + ell_tau, the far-end transport defect), S1_end = S1(ell)
definitions.t7: crude certified sups (coefficient sums over element x slab): r, A, r_x, A_x = kappa r on [0,34.25] and on x >= 10.25; supArho_tip = sup |A rho'/rho|, supAx_far = sup |A|/x
definitions.base_corrected: T6 run on the (SE)-corrected base itself (review B1): kap^ = kap~ + (a1/ell) B(u) + (a2/ell^2) B'(u), u = x/ell in [0.6, 0.8], a1 = -(theta~(ell) + 3pi/2), a2 the root of Im W^(ell) = 0 (Banach per tc, enclosure eps_a2), a1', a2' exact/implicit; p2/t6c/slabc.py (T6 engine, the two window elements cut at u = 0.6, 0.8; slab 11 cut in time at the knot crossing). Replaces the increments of p2/se_corr.py.
